title: "Knowing When You Don't Know”: A Multilingual Relevance Assessment Dataset for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM robustness in terms of factual correctness and ability to identify relevant passages, primarily measuring hallucination and error rates. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The use of 'faithful responses' refers to factual adherence to retrieved documents.
